title: Abracadabra

Pay the toll to the angels向那天使交付通行费

Drawing circles in the clouds于云端勾勒着圆圈

Keep your mind on the distance将思绪遥寄远方

When the devil turns around当恶魔蓦然转过身来

Hold me in your heart tonight今夜 将我紧拥入你心怀

In the magic of the dark moonlight还有那暗夜月光的奇妙魔力 噢

Like a poem said by a lady in red恰似红衣皇后吟诵的诗篇

You hear the last few words of your life你聆听着生命 最后的只言片语

It's time to cast your spell on the night是时候在这夜幕 施展你的魔法
